decision.observation: Standing at the parapet/chain-link fence; below is the adjacent lower rooftop and the smoke plume. Dark shapes along the parapet ledge to the right, plus debris on the rooftop floor ahead. HUD bars green.
decision.hypothesis: The chain-link/parapet blocks direct access to the cross pad; the black parapet device (radio) sighted earlier may be the trigger to call extraction. Follow the parapet right to find it.
decision.memory: Parapet blocks helipad access; look for black parapet radio device along ledge.
